body:
emma (support): Customer says UI intermittently shows "Failed to load assistant"; they see a 401/403 in console once in a while. Asked for HAR + console logs + request-id. Any quick repro instructions I can send?

devon (eng): Send this short checklist: reproduce in Incognito, open DevTools, enable Preserve log, disable cache, reproduce the error, then right-click Network -> Save all as HAR. Also ask for the exact request-id string from the failing request and the wall-clock time.

sanjay (eng): Chrome steps I paste to customer:
1) Open Chrome -> More Tools -> Developer Tools (F12)
2) Network tab -> check "Preserve log" and check "Disable cache" (while DevTools open)
3) Console tab -> keep open so console errors are captured
4) Reproduce the issue (reload / perform action)
5) In Network tab -> right-click -> "Save all as HAR with content" and attach file
6) In Console -> right-click the error -> "Save as..." or copy the stack text
7) If possible: right-click the failing request -> Copy -> "Copy as cURL (bash)" and paste the curl output

Also ask them to include: workspace/org name, user email (if applicable), approximate timestamp (UTC), and whether they were on VPN or a corporate proxy.

emma (support): Can you paste a short curl example we can give them so they can sanity-check request shape (redact token)?

devon (eng): Example curl (redact your token and API host):
```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED_TOKEN>" 
     -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
     -H "X-Request-Id: <PASTE_REQUEST_ID_HERE>" 
     -d '{"model":"gpt-...","input":"test"}' 
     "https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat/completions"
```
Tell them to paste both the curl command and the full response + response headers (especially x-request-id and any x-error-code).

devon (eng): If customer can't attach HAR, quick filters they can paste: open the HAR in a text editor and grep for "/v1/chat" or search for the request-id. Example jq to pull entries (if they can run jq):
```bash
jq -r '.log.entries[] | select(.request.url | contains("/v1/chat")) | {url: .request.url, status: .response.status, requestHeaders: .request.headers}' file.har
```

sanjay (eng): Safari notes (attachments sometimes miss body): use Web Inspector -> Network -> Preserve Log, then File -> Export as HAR. For Safari, advise they disable content blockers/extension and try without Intelligent Tracking Prevention if they suspect cookies.

emma (support): I'll send a trimmed template to the customer including those steps + a link to upload the HAR to our secure upload endpoint. Anything else to add?

devon (eng): Add: ask them to check the browser's system clock and retry if it's off-by-more-than-5s (auth tokens can fail). Also ask whether they saw any CORS errors in console; if so include exact message.

ingest-bot: debug-bundle received: https://uploads.redwood.example/receive/abc123 (customer-uploaded file). :white_check_mark:

emma (support): Got it — flagging for triage, will attach the HAR + curl in the ticket and ping eng with x-request-id. Thanks!
